screen.wotn.mastery.title: WHISPERS OF THE NORTH
screen.wotn.mastery.tree_help: Drag to move  |  Wheel to navigate  |  Double-click to unlock
screen.wotn.node.root.description: The core of the Leviathan Axe mastery tree.
screen.wotn.node.throw.description: Throw the axe, freeze targets and call the weapon back to your hand.
screen.wotn.node.quick_return.descriptio: A future modifier that will reduce the axe return time.
screen.wotn.node.imbue.description: Channel frost through the blade and temporarily empower every strike.
screen.wotn.node.deep_freeze.description: A future passive that will intensify the weapon's freezing power.
screen.wotn.node.spikes.description: Strike the ground and summon a widening formation of spikes before you.
screen.wotn.node.glacial_reach.descripti: A future modifier that will extend the range and area of the spikes.
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.name: Haldor
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.greeting: The cold ruins common steel. Fortunately, I do not work with common steel. What do you need?
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.open_forge: I want to see the forge.
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.ask_runes: What do you know about these runes?
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.about: I have worked for kings, gods, and men who thought themselves both. These days, I prefer weapons that do not lie.
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.runes: A rune does not create power. It teaches the metal to remember the power it already holds.
dialogue.wotn.common.back: I want to ask something else.
dialogue.wotn.requirement.leviathan: Requires the Leviathan Axe in your inventory
screen.wotn.mastery.no_eligible_weapons: No compatible weapon was found in your inventory.
screen.wotn.mastery.empty_description: Bring a weapon that can receive runic upgrades so the blacksmith can reveal its mastery tree.
